item.title: Scripps agrees to sell Court TV to Law&Crime Network
item.description: The E.W. Scripps Company has reached an agreement to sell its Court TV network to Law&Crime — the multiplatform true crime and legal content studio created and led by ABC News Chief Legal Analyst Dan Abrams and now owned by media creator holding company Jellysmack. The post Scripps agrees to sell Court TV to Law&Crime Network first appeared on Law & Crime.

item.title: Mike Lindell bought his own books in 'bulk' from MyPillow rather than paying Smartmatic sanctions: Court filing
item.description: Smartmatic alerted a judge to the Mike Lindell campaign expenditures for 2025, showing he spent on "bulk" buys of his own book rather than paying sanctions. The post Mike Lindell bought his own books in 'bulk' from MyPillow rather than paying Smartmatic sanctions: Court filing first appeared on Law & Crime.

item.title: 'Do something about it': Man killed soon-to-be grandad in public park after girlfriend said victim had disrespected her, DA says
item.description: Michael Thompson is accused of killing a 40-year-old man in a Massachusetts park after his girlfriend said the victim had been disrespectful and demanded he "do something." The post 'Do something about it': Man killed soon-to-be grandad in public park after girlfriend said victim had disrespected her, DA says first appeared on Law & Crime.

item.title: Mom of 5 taking smoke break from Bank of America job is randomly gunned down outside branch, family says
item.description: A North Carolina woman who worked some 20 years as a Bank of America employee was shot to death as she smoked a cigarette outside a Charlotte branch, her family believes. The post Mom of 5 taking smoke break from Bank of America job is randomly gunned down outside branch, family says first appeared on Law & Crime.

item.title: 'Give me a really good sniper': Man vows to 'kill Trump' more than 20 times and gun down any officer who showed up at his doorstep, DOJ says
item.description: A Texas man is accused of spewing assassination threats online about President Donald Trump and ICE agents, with one alleged post on YouTube featuring the words "KILL TRUMP" more than 20 times. item.title: Deputy moonlighting as scuba instructor charged after 12-year-old drowns during class
item.description: Armstrong worked a full daytime shift and an overnight shift at his second job. By the time he got to class, he had "little or no sleep in the past 24 hours." item.title: ICE is 'flipping the bird' at judge's warrantless arrest order as agents continue to snatch 'parents and families' off the streets without checking flight risk: Lawyers
item.description: ICE agents in Colorado have been "flipping the bird" at an order barring warrantless arrests without flight risk checks as they keep snatching up "parents and families," immigration lawyers say. item.title: 'Selfish' wife ambushed husband with fatal dose of animal tranquilizer during custody exchange of 3 daughters
item.description: Amanda Hovanec pleaded guilty in Ohio state court to ambushing her husband with a fatal dose of M-99 during a 2022 custody exchange of their daughters. item.title: Nursing home worker kept wristwatch as memento after he murdered patient in a crawl space at his girlfriend's parents' house
item.description: A 36-year-old man murdered a patient he knew from his time working at an assisted living facility, ditching her body in a crawl space at his girlfriend's house and keeping a trophy from his kill. item.title: Daughter left with no parents and 'life-altering' injuries after DUI driver plowed into car while family was heading home from church: Police
item.description: The Santa Clarita Sheriff's Office said one of the parents was pronounced dead at the scene; the other was taken to a hospital and succumbed to their injuries.
